name: Flat drink
summary: Flat drink or container: mug, glass, wine, bottle, can, carton or takeaway cup with liquid, ice, foam and steam.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the item rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the drink is hero size; use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: vessel
params.note: cup = on a saucer, tall = juice or smoothie, stemmed = milkshake, tumbler = chai glass, takeaway = paper coffee cup

params.name: h
params.note: height px (default by vessel: mug 300, bottle 480)

params.name: color
params.note: vessel colour; glass vessels default to pale #DDEFF8

params.name: level
params.note: liquid fill, 0 to 1 of the height

params.name: foam
params.note: foam or cream top colour, or none

params.name: garnish
params.note: on the rim or the foam

params.name: label
params.note: plain band or label colour, no text, or none

params.name: lid
params.note: cap or lid colour for bottle, jar, can and takeaway, or none

params.name: anim
params.note: slosh = the liquid surface tilts gently

author: krakujs
